summary: LDAP is operational on node1 for dc=branch,dc=test. Node2 finds Alex and Sam with unchanged identities and mail addresses. Anonymous writes return LDAP error 50, while authenticated administrator updates succeed. Both nodes restarted individually and recovered with changed boot IDs; the OS release and kernel remain unchanged.

Created and enabled the branch directory instance, imported the staged LDIF, configured read/search access, and opened LDAP through firewalld.
Generated the administrator credential on node1 and retained it in a root-only file without exposing it.
Validated authenticated updates and anonymous-write rejection.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified post-restart recovery.

evidence.summary: Created the branch instance, imported the people entries, and confirmed the enabled service listening on port 389.
